title: The Gita
style_lock: Premium high-quality charming painted comic / Amar Chitra mythology; dawn cream-saffron-gold battlefield; refined linework
frame: Ornate lotus carved wooden frame on every plate

arjuna.costume: Cream dhoti gold, light armor, bow

plates.beat_text: On the field of Kurukshetra the two oceans of war face each other at dawn.
must_show: Premium painted comic epic Kurukshetra plain at dawn
Two armies facing across field, banners, soft gold light
plates.prompt: Premium painted comic Amar Chitra. Wide Kurukshetra plain at cream-saffron dawn. Two vast ancient armies face each other with banners and chariots, epic and solemn, no gore. Ornate lotus frame. Not photoreal.

plates.beat_text: Conches sound. Banners lift. Kin stand ready to strike kin.
must_show: Warriors raising conches and banners, tension before battle
plates.prompt: Premium painted comic Amar Chitra. Close-mid of ancient Indian warriors lifting conch shells and battle banners at dawn. Epic tension. Ornate lotus frame. Not photoreal, not gory.

plates.beat_text: Arjuna asks Krishna to drive between the hosts — to see those he must fight.
must_show: Krishna as charioteer yellow pitambar; Arjuna with bow on chariot between armies
plates.prompt: Premium painted comic Amar Chitra. Krishna in yellow pitambar drives chariot; Arjuna warrior with bow stands behind him looking toward the opposing army. Dawn field. Ornate lotus frame. Not photoreal.

plates.beat_text: His bow slips. Teachers, cousins, friends — his heart collapses into grief.
must_show: Arjuna collapsed in grief on chariot, bow slipped; Krishna watching with compassion
plates.prompt: Premium painted comic Amar Chitra. Arjuna sinks in despair on the chariot, Gandiva bow slipped from his hand, face full of grief. Krishna turns with compassion. Soft golden light. Ornate lotus frame. Dignified emotion, not photoreal.

plates.beat_text: Krishna speaks: the soul is not slain; the body is only a garment.
must_show: Intimate teaching: Krishna speaking, Arjuna listening on chariot
plates.prompt: Premium painted comic Amar Chitra. Close two-shot on chariot: Krishna teaches with calm raised hand; Arjuna listens, still sorrowful. Soft gold dawn. Ornate lotus frame. Not photoreal.

plates.beat_text: Act without clinging to the fruit. Stand in your dharma as a warrior.
must_show: Krishna pointing to duty; Arjuna beginning to straighten with resolve
plates.prompt: Premium painted comic Amar Chitra. Krishna counsels Arjuna about duty and detachment; Arjuna’s posture lifts with growing resolve. Chariot between soft-blurred armies. Ornate lotus frame. Not photoreal.

plates.beat_text: Then Krishna shows the cosmic form — time itself devouring worlds.
must_show: Tasteful Vishvarupa: Krishna radiant multi-armed cosmic form, soft gold-saffron light, Arjuna awed with hands joined — charming comic not horror CGI
plates.prompt: Premium painted comic Amar Chitra. Krishna reveals cosmic Vishvarupa form — radiant many-armed divine presence with soft gold and saffron light, sacred awe. Arjuna bows with joined hands. Mythic charming style NOT horror CGI. Ornate lotus frame. Not photoreal.

plates.beat_text: Arjuna’s confusion burns away. He takes up the bow again.
must_show: Arjuna standing firm lifting bow; Krishna smiling as charioteer
plates.prompt: Premium painted comic Amar Chitra. Arjuna rises on the chariot, lifts his bow with calm warrior resolve. Krishna smiles as charioteer. Dawn light stronger. Ornate lotus frame. Not photoreal.

plates.beat_text: So the song of the Lord was sung between two armies — and the war of ages began.
must_show: Premium quality gold closing mood like Ep01 wide-gold
Chariot ready between armies, sacred calm before storm
plates.prompt: Premium painted comic Amar Chitra closing plate. Warm cream-saffron-gold Kurukshetra dawn. Krishna and Arjuna’s chariot stands ready between two soft armies — sacred calm before battle. Ornate lotus frame. Match Ep01 gold mood. Not photoreal.
